personality_one_liner: A professional, data-friendly financial dashboard infused with the warm, appetizing tones of a modern artisan bakery.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native vertical rhythm. Cards padded well to avoid cramped data. Use md for inner component spacing and lg for screen edge padding.

do's: Use glass on the bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Apply glass to sticky headers over scrolling content
Use glass for floating action buttons or sticky CTA bottoms
dont's: Never apply glass to regular data cards or form inputs
Do not use blur behind dense text lists

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Simple email/password authentication for the bakery owner.

states.error: Inline text below the failed input field

screens.layout: Centered form over a subtle background photo or warm gradient. Use large inputs with clear labels. Sticky submit button avoiding keyboard.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A high-level view of finances and operations: revenue, expenses, active POs, and top variants.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for metric cards and chart area
states.empty: Welcome state suggesting adding the first PO or expense
states.error: Error card with a retry button

screens.layout: Use tabular numbers for KPIs (Revenue, Expenses, Profit). Place a prominent trend chart below the KPIs. Add a horizontal scrolling section for 'Top-Selling Variants'. Keep layout single-column to maintain order.

screens.name: Orders (PO Management)
screens.purpose: Track and manage Pre-Orders (Pending, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled).

states.empty: Illustration of an empty bakery basket with 'No Active Orders' text

screens.layout: Sticky horizontal filter chips at the top (glass background). Each list item is a card containing customer name, items summary, price, and status indicator. Tapping opens a full-screen detail view with a sticky primary action (Update Status).

screens.name: Expenses
screens.purpose: Log and categorize outgoing costs (Raw Materials, Packaging, Transport, Utilities, Other).

states.empty: Empty state illustration with 'Add your first expense' CTA

screens.layout: Header with 'Total Expenses' summary. Floating Action Button (FAB) or sticky bottom CTA to add a new expense. List categorized by month/week.

screens.name: Products
screens.purpose: Manage the 7 saltbread variants, images, and prices.
screens.layout: 2-column grid. Each card features a clear, large product image, name, and price. Rounded corners with generous whitespace so the bakery items shine.

hero_login.alt: Modern bakery storefront with warm lighting

instructions_to_main_agent: Design Principles: Follow iOS-Native Clean but use warm, bakery-inspired colors (Ochre/Amber) instead of default tech blues.
Data Display: Use Plus Jakarta Sans. Ensure numbers in the dashboard (revenue, profit) are clear and use tabular lining so they align vertically.
Navigation: Implement a max 4-tab bottom navigation (Dashboard, Orders, Expenses, Products). Ensure the tab bar uses glassmorphism if content scrolls behind it.
Cards & Shadow: Use slight shadows (tier 1) for main container cards. Avoid heavy shadows or borders.
Images & Visuals: Use the provided images for the variants. If rendering text over images (e.g., login hero), use a gradient-to-dark scrim pattern to ensure WCAG AA readability.
Action Buttons: Primary actions (like 'Update PO Status', 'Save Expense') must be sticky at the bottom of the screen to remain accessible during scroll.
